en.basics_01: Here at Fraction Farms, we showcase how to divide up land in order to produce crops more efficiently.
en.basics_02: We do this by taking Unit Tiles and breaking their sides into fractional lengths.
en.basics_03: For each side, there is a back and forward button to increase and decrease the number of parts each side is divided up into.
en.basics_04: We can select each individual piece to count up the number of fractional tiles that intersect with the portion of the area we are looking to use.
en.basics_05: Once you have selected the right number of tiles, you can click the submit button to check your results.
en.basics_08: You're a fast learner! Great job!
en.basics_09: Notice how the solution we are getting is the same as if we multiplied the fractions together, multiplying the numerators togehter and the denominators together.
en.basics_11: Wonderful! You've mastered working with one tile, but dividing up land sometimes takes multiple tiles.
en.basics_12: Let's move one another part of the farm!
